headline: Tiny longer-period SE — dawn log session only.
today: Sub-foot with a bit of period on a good angle, and the wind goes SE/SSE cross-on by mid-morning. Light NNW at dawn is the window if you want to log a few. Nothing to rearrange your day for.

daysToWatch.note: Deceptive — nearly 4ft but on a marginal SSE angle, so expect junk regardless of size. Wind's manageable but the direction kills it.
The standout. Up to 3.3ft at 8.9s on a prime ESE angle. Wind's cross NE-ish so it won't be glassy, but this is the day to prioritize. Shortboard.
